notify.error: Something went wrong. Check the Noctalia log for details.

max_items.label: Max items shown
max_items.description: Maximum number of notifications listed on the widget.

group_notifications.label: Group by sender
group_notifications.description: Merge notifications with the same app and title into one card with a count badge. Turn off to give every notification its own card.

show_icons.label: Show app icons
show_icons.description: Show the sender icon, or the image the app provided, at the start of each card.

show_age.label: Show age
show_age.description: Show how long ago each notification arrived, on the right of the card.

summary_length.label: Title length
summary_length.description: How many characters of the title are shown before truncation. It also fixes the widget width: longer text, wider widget.

card_density.label: Card density
card_density.description: Vertical padding and spacing between cards.

card_background.label: Card background
card_background.description: How strong the rounded background behind each notification is.

text_scale.label: Text size
text_scale.description: Content size. The plugin cannot read the box size set in the editor, so it renders at fixed sizes picked here.

show_body.label: Show body
show_body.description: Show the notification body under each summary line.

list_mode.label: List mode
list_mode.description: Unread only: the list empties when the control center is opened. All: a rolling recap of the last notifications, never auto-cleared (click to empty).

language.label: Language
language.description: Language of the widget texts. Auto follows Noctalia's resolved language (system locale). This page's labels follow the shell language instead.

order.label: Order
order.description: Newest notifications at the top, or keep arrival order (oldest first).

age_format.label: Age format
age_format.description: How each entry's age is shown.

max_age.label: Maximum age (hours)
max_age.description: Entries older than this many hours leave the list on their own. 0 keeps them forever.

hide_empty.label: Hide when empty
hide_empty.description: Hide the widget entirely instead of showing the empty state.
